findings.evidenceJa: その事実が、彼女の心を一層深く沈ませる。
findings.governingReading: The fact sinks her heart yet deeper: boy risks danger while she rests as its cause.
findings.explanation: Deepening distress becomes realizing the situation.

findings.highlight: She'd prefer to live the rest of it for him.
findings.evidenceJa: それならせめて、彼にだけは生きていてほしい。
findings.governingReading: Since she has little time, at least she wants him alone to go on living.
findings.explanation: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.

findings.highlight: All their squirming in her body starts to make her ears ring.
findings.evidenceJa: 体内で蠢く耳鳴りがする。
findings.governingReading: She experiences a tinnitus/ringing that writhes within her body; pathological internal sound image.
findings.explanation: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.

findings.highlight: The dark longing makes her stumble, and she tumbles to the ground in a tangle of hair and limbs.
findings.evidenceJa: 体は昏い恋しさに躓いてすぐに倒れ、卑しく地面にすがりつく。
findings.governingReading: Body stumbles over dark longing, falls immediately and abjectly clings to ground.
findings.explanation: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.

findings.highlight: She can't stop breathing. Her spine fuses together like sticky sap.
findings.evidenceJa: 止まらない呼吸、粘体のように切なく融ける脊椎。
findings.governingReading: Spine poignantly melts like viscous matter.

findings.highlight: "...I'll go if you if you order it. But Sakura, your body will not last much longer. Having me act will only shorten your remaining life. Are you sure about this?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「……命令ならば従います。ですがサクラ。貴女の体とて長くはない。私を行使するという事は、貴女の余命を削る事です。それでもいいのですね？」
findings.governingReading: Rider will obey if command, with explicit remaining-life cost warning.

findings.highlight: I'm still myself now, but if I lose focus, I don't know what I'll do... My memories are getting more vague each day, and I can't feel my arms and legs anymore. My sense of time is all over the place, and I can't even keep track of a day anymore.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はちゃんとしてるけど、気を抜くとね、自分が何をしていたか分からなくなるの。……日に日に記憶が曖昧になって、手足の感覚もない。時間の感覚だってもうバラバラで、一日が長く続いてくれないんだ。
findings.governingReading: When focus slips she no longer knows what she had been doing; memories vague, limb sensations gone and subjective day fragmented.
findings.explanation: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.

findings.highlight: ...Even this morning, when I watched Senpai leave, it felt like a whole week went by."
findings.evidenceJa: ……今朝だって。なんか、先輩を見送ってから、一週間ぐらい経ってる気がするの」
findings.governingReading: Though she saw him off this morning it feels a week has passed since doing so.
findings.explanation: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.

findings.highlight: Until now, she's never made so much as a suggestion.
findings.evidenceJa: それが今のように、自ら彼女を案じるなど今までなかった事だ。
findings.governingReading: What surprises Sakura is Rider taking the initiative to express concern for her in this way.
findings.explanation: Sakura's surprise at Rider's unsolicited concern becomes surprise that Rider has offered any suggestion. This weakens the explicit recognition of care between them.
